title: Microsoft's Cloud Accelerates to Fastest Growth Since 2022
excerpt: Microsoft cloud unit grew at the fastest pace in four years, suggesting that the company's computing infrastructure and artificial intelligence services cont...
content_html:
Bloomberg

Wed, July 29, 2026 at 2:24 PM PDT

Microsoft cloud unit grew at the fastest pace in four years, suggesting that the company's computing infrastructure and artificial intelligence services continue to make inroads with businesses.Azure cloud-computing revenue increased 43% during the fiscal fourth quarter, the company said Wednesday in a statement. That was the fastest quarterly growth since early 2022, and topped analysts' average growth estimate of about 40%. Azure sales topped $100 billion for the first time during the fiscal year ended in June. Bloomberg Tech Host Ed Ludlow reacts to earnings
